prompt: The ledger (`left.csv`) carries one row per invoice for its full value. The customer settled this invoice across several smaller payments, each of which appears as its own row in `right.csv` carrying the same invoice number. Columns are date, amount, currency, reference, description; dates look like 2024-01-31. Write a `reconify.yaml` that reconciles the invoice against its payments without reporting the individual payments as repeated entries.
